About.title: About
About.intro: I am a Kuwait-based AI and digital transformation consultant, living and working in Kuwait since 2009. For more than 15 years I have worked where business meets technology: IT and network administration, IT consulting, digital media and marketing, and, since 2022, digital solutions and AI.
About.approach: That path matters. The technical foundation means I build and run systems myself; the marketing years mean I think about the people who will use a solution as much as the technology behind it.
About.experienceLine: Over the past 12 months I have been delivering AI solutions for large enterprises and public-sector organisations: AI avatar and assistant systems, document-intelligence and legal-content portals, AI model gateways and process automation agents.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Short answers to what management teams usually ask before starting.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: Mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC with mature management, who value quality over price. My recent delivery work has been for large enterprises and public-sector organisations, and I bring the same standard to mid-sized companies.

items.question: How do engagements usually work?
items.answer: We start with a discovery call. From there, the first step is usually either a readiness and strategy phase or a clearly defined build. Each phase has its own scope and is agreed separately, so you only commit to the next step.

items.question: Do your solutions work in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. I work in Arabic and English, and solutions are designed for both languages from the start, including Arabic content and right-to-left interfaces.

items.question: How do you handle data security? Can the solution be self-hosted?
items.answer: Where your data is processed and who can access it are agreed in the design step, in line with your internal policies. Self-hosting is part of that discussion: I run self-hosted components in my own operations stack, including secrets management and a web-intelligence service.

items.question: Which AI models do you work with?
items.answer: I work with several model families, including Claude, Codex/GPT and open models. The choice depends on the task, your data requirements and cost, and an AI model gateway lets you use more than one without being tied to a single provider.

items.question: How do you keep AI costs under control?
items.answer: Through governance built into the design: an AI model gateway gives management visibility of usage and control over which models are used for what. I run the same kind of cost control across models in my own work.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Request a discovery call on WhatsApp. We discuss your goals and current situation, and I suggest a sensible first step.
